{{ModeInfobox |image1 = |-|Icon = [[File:Tutorial2026Icon.png]] |-|Icon = [[File:TutorialBanner.png]] |map = [[Tutorial]] |waves = 5 |starting_cash = {{Money|1,000}} |rewards = {{Coins|100}} & {{Exp|50}} |chapter = TDS: Boot Camp |previous_mission = [[Boot Camp]] |next_mission = [[Breach Protocol]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Use Demoman's splash damage to stop fast enemies and splitting Breakers.|In-game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Live Fire''' is the second mission for the tutorial chapter of the [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. The loadout for this map is set to be the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]] and [[Demoman]]. Sell cost of all towers is also 100% of their total price. Base health is set to infinity and [[Skills]] are disabled. ==Rewards== '''Live Fire''' gives a one time reward of {{Coins|100}} and {{Exp|50}}.
